_comment: LiveKit SFU for Nexus. Needs 2 allocations: primary (TCP signaling + UDP media) and one for ICE/TCP. See docs/PTERODACTYL.md.
name: Nexus LiveKit
author: admin@nexus.local
description: Self-hosted LiveKit SFU (media only) using the official release binary, configured for Pterodactyl with a single UDP port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Downloads the launcher; it installs/updates the official livekit-server
# binary (github.com/livekit/livekit) on every start.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
REPO="${GITHUB_REPO:-zyypj/nexus}"
curl -fsSL -o livekit-start.sh "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/livekit-start.sh"
chmod +x livekit-start.sh
rm -f .livekit-version
echo "Installed. LiveKit is downloaded on first start."

variables.name: LiveKit version
variables.description: Official livekit-server release to run (tested: 1.13.9). Use latest to follow new releases.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: 1 = install the configured version on start when it differs from the installed one.

variables.name: GitHub repository (launcher)
variables.description: Where the installer downloads livekit-start.sh from.

variables.name: API key
variables.description: Key name shared with the Nexus server.

variables.name: API secret
variables.description: Random secret, at least 32 characters (e.g. openssl rand -hex 32). Same value in the Nexus egg.

variables.name: Public IP
variables.description: Public IPv4 of the node, announced to clients. Empty = discover via STUN.

variables.name: Signaling port
variables.description: Empty = primary allocation (recommended). TCP for signaling.

variables.name: UDP media port
variables.description: Empty = same number as the primary allocation (its UDP side). All WebRTC UDP goes through this one port.

variables.name: ICE/TCP port
variables.description: Port of the SECOND allocation, used when a network blocks UDP.

variables.name: Webhook URL
variables.description: Nexus webhook, e.g. http://203.0.113.5:3000/api/livekit/webhook (keeps call state correct when a client crashes).

variables.name: Enable TURN
variables.description: Embedded TURN for very restrictive networks. Needs an extra allocation (and a certificate for TLS).

variables.name: TURN TLS port
variables.description: Allocation for TURN/TLS (optional, needs cert/key files).
